instances.name: Numbered heading bottom rule
instances.why: The source numbered heading has a separate thin bottom rule. The sole headline base on page05 has no rule, and the admitted big/center/on variants do not describe a ruled numbered heading. Applying a new unnamed design or a page condition would violate the extraction contract.

instances.name: Shared comparison row rule
instances.design: 원본 영역 333,411,800,1. The source has a thin rule between three independent before/after rows. delta.change owns one pair and has no multi-row or rule variant; inspecting sibling order would violate the reusable element rule. A comparison-rows owner with delta children is required to own these two shared rules.
